entrypoints.summary: Calls to net/netip Addr.IsGlobalUnicast, IsInterfaceLocalMulticast, IsLinkLocalMulticast, IsLoopback, IsMulticast, or IsPrivate on an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address.

mitigations.concept: upgrade net/netip to fixed Go release
preserve IPv4-mapped and IPv4 classification equivalence

relation_candidates.rationale: The documented affected predicates return false for this address representation where their traditional IPv4 form returns true.
A false result contrary to the corresponding IPv4 result is the documented incorrect classification outcome.
A consuming application can receive the incorrect predicate result; whether it makes a security-sensitive policy decision is not shown.
A policy decision error is a plausible dependent consequence but is not directly demonstrated by the supplied advisory.

relation_candidates.dst: upgrade net/netip to fixed Go release
relation_candidates.rationale: The reviewed metadata specifies fixed releases and identifies the linked CL as the fix.

relation_candidates.dst: preserve IPv4-mapped and IPv4 classification equivalence
relation_candidates.rationale: Restoring the documented classification equivalence prevents the false-result condition.

impact.affected_asset: Correctness of net/netip address-classification decisions and any dependent policy decisions.
impact.attacker_capability: Where an application accepts attacker-influenced address values and relies on an affected predicate, the actor may cause a false classification result by using an IPv4-mapped IPv6 representation; downstream security consequences are not evidenced in this bundle.

causal_trace.summary: An IPv4-mapped IPv6 address is supplied to one of the affected net/netip Addr classification methods.
The classification result should agree with the address's traditional IPv4 form for the documented affected predicates, but this representation-equivalence property did not hold.
The affected Is methods returned false for IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses whose traditional IPv4 forms would return true.
Consumers relying on these predicate results can misclassify IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses; the supplied advisory does not establish a particular downstream authorization or network-policy bypass.

failure.operation: Addr Is-method address classification returning false for an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address

primary_invariant.statement: For the affected address-classification predicates, an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address must receive the same applicable true classification as its embedded traditional IPv4 representation.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The advisory and issue state that the methods returned false for mapped addresses when the corresponding traditional IPv4 forms returned true.

quality.review_notes: The official advisory and reviewed release metadata clearly identify the behavior, affected symbols, and fixed versions. The bundled CL artifact contained no readable diff or tests, so no implementation-level patch semantics, test path, build command, or observed test execution is asserted. The advisory establishes semantic misclassification only; concrete exploitability depends on a downstream consumer and is not supplied.

remediation.invariant_restored: Use a release containing the referenced fix so the affected predicates no longer return false solely because an address is represented as IPv4-mapped IPv6 when the traditional IPv4 form would return true.
